notes.title: Update on November 28th
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fix Details[/b]

*Fixed an issue where tank shells could penetrate the player's barrier.

*Resolved a problem where the player could be attacked by enemies while selecting floors in the elevator.

*Fixed an issue where the player's animation would stop during cutscenes.

*Corrected a bug where enemies would constantly recognize the player.

notes.title: October 22 Mini Update Details
notes.content:
*Fixed the collision on the rooftops of buildings in the city area of Chapter 9.

*Corrected enemy AI behavior.

notes.title: Major update on October 15, 2024!
notes.content:
Update Details

1.Improved Processing Load

*Optimized processing load in all areas.

2.Improved Game Flow Clarity

*Relocated the boss fight area in Chapter 1.
*Changed important item icons to be displayed in 3D space when using the remote viewing skill.
*Added destination animation markers to the mini-map for each chapter.
*Minor text discrepancies have been corrected.
*Moved puzzle room hints to more visible locations.
*Repositioned the coins in puzzle rooms to more noticeable spots.

3.Improved Enemy AI

*Enhanced the AI to relentlessly pursue players within the laboratory floors.
*Adjusted shielded enemies so that their exposed areas are easier to hit.

4.Improved Player Actions

*Implemented TurnInPlace functionality.
*Improved camera behavior.
*Enhanced attack abilities.
